fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready's epic semanticops.com#31 reached GitHub's 100 sub-issue cap, so new work cannot be linked under the group
fieldValues.summary: On 2026-11-09 the analyst linked 8 issues under semanticops.com#31 and the parent reached 100 sub-issues; the ninth link (srs-web#336, moving from its parked epic srs-web#322) was refused. Closed sub-issues count toward the cap, so the group epic will refuse every further link until some are removed or the group gains intermediate stories.
evidence: 2026-11-09 12:5x UTC: POST repos/the-greenman/semanticops.com/issues/31/sub_issues for srs-web#336 returned HTTP 422 "Parent cannot have more than 100 sub-issues and Sub issue may only have one parent"
GET repos/the-greenman/semanticops.com/issues/31/sub_issues?per_page=100 returns 100 entries after the run linked srs#1018, srs#1019, srs-rust#1409, #1619, #1620, #1621, #1622, #1623
clerk flow --chain srs-web#336: ✗ epic: muDemocracy.org#83 is not ranked (parked); the issue cannot be moved to the group epic
fieldValues.body: Stage: 4. Shape the work. The group's report issue is also its epic, so every issue the group has ever taken stays a sub-issue after it closes. Obvious remedies (suggestion only): detach closed sub-issues from #31 on a schedule, or give the group intermediate stories (one per cluster) under #31 and file work under those.
